Title: Mark batch attendance with valid payload
Description: Verify marking batch attendance with valid list of AttendanceDTO objects
Test Steps: Prepare a list of valid AttendanceDTO objects with employeeId and absent fields
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as JSON body
Verify the response
Expected Result: Response contains savedCount equal to 2, presentCount equal to 1, absentCount equal to 1, invalidEntries is empty list, and savedRecords list with two attendance records

Title: Mark batch attendance with empty payload
Description: Verify response when POST /mark-batch is called with empty list
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty list as JSON body
Verify the response
Expected Result: Response contains message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark batch attendance with null payload
Description: Verify response when POST /mark-batch is called with null body
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with null body
Verify the response
Expected Result: Response contains message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark batch attendance with some invalid entries
Description: Verify marking batch attendance with some AttendanceDTO objects missing employeeId or absent fields
Test Steps: Prepare a list of AttendanceDTO objects where some have null employeeId or absent
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as JSON body
Verify the response
Expected Result: Response contains savedCount equal to 2, presentCount equal to 1, absentCount equal to 1, invalidEntries list containing employeeId 3, and savedRecords list with two attendance records

Title: Mark batch attendance with all invalid entries
Description: Verify marking batch attendance with all AttendanceDTO objects missing employeeId or absent fields
Test Steps: Prepare a list of AttendanceDTO objects all missing employeeId or absent fields
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as JSON body
Verify the response
Expected Result: Response contains savedCount equal to 0, presentCount equal to 0, absentCount equal to 0, invalidEntries list containing employeeId 2, and savedRecords empty list

Title: Get all employees
Description: Verify that GET /api/employee returns list of all employees
Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee
Expected Result: Response contains list of all employees

Title: Get all employees when no employees exist
Description: Verify that GET /api/employee returns empty list when no employees exist
Pre-Conditions: No employees exist in the repository
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee
Expected Result: Response contains empty list

Title: Get employee by valid id
Description: Verify that the API returns employee details when a valid id is provided
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee/{id} with valid employee id
Expected Result: Response contains employee details for the given id

Title: Get employee by null id
Description: Verify that the API returns bad request error when id is null
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null
Expected Result: Response contains message 'id is required'

Title: Get employee by non-existing id
Description: Verify that the API returns not found error when employee does not exist
Pre-Conditions: No employee exists with the given id
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing employee id
Expected Result: Response contains message 'employee not found'

Title: Create employee with valid data
Description: Verify creating an employee with valid name, role, and id
Pre-Conditions: Employee does not exist with given id
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with valid employee JSON containing id, name, and role
Expected Result: Response status 201 Created with employee data in response body and Location header set

Title: Create employee with missing name
Description: Verify creating an employee fails when name is missing
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON missing name but with id and role
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with missing role
Description: Verify creating an employee fails when role is missing
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON missing role but with id and name
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with empty name
Description: Verify creating an employee fails when name is empty string
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON having empty name and valid role and id
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with empty role
Description: Verify creating an employee fails when role is empty string
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON having empty role and valid name and id
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with null body
Description: Verify creating an employee fails when request body is null
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with null body
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with missing id
Description: Verify creating an employee fails when id is missing
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON missing id but with valid name and role
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Update employee with valid id and valid body
Description: Verify updating an existing employee with valid id and valid request body updates the employee and returns status 200
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id and valid employee data in body
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains updated employee data with new values

Title: Update employee with null id
Description: Verify updating employee with null id returns bad request with message 'id is required'
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null and valid employee data in body
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request and response body contains message 'id is required'

Title: Update employee with null request body
Description: Verify updating employee with null request body returns bad request with message 'request body is required'
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id and null request body
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request and response body contains message 'request body is required'

Title: Update employee with non-existing id
Description: Verify updating employee with id that does not exist returns 404 with message 'employee not found'
Pre-Conditions: No employee exists with given id in the repository
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing id and valid employee data in body
Expected Result: Response status is 404 Not Found and response body contains message 'employee not found'

Title: Update employee with partial fields in request body
Description: Verify updating employee with partial fields updates only those fields and returns status 200
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id and partial employee data in body
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains employee data with updated name and unchanged other fields

Title: Delete employee with valid id
Description: Verify deleting an existing employee by valid id returns 204 status
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with valid existing id
Expected Result: Response status is 204 No Content and employee is deleted

Title: Delete employee with non-existing id
Description: Verify deleting an employee with non-existing id returns 404 status with message
Pre-Conditions: No employee exists with the given id
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing id
Expected Result: Response status is 404 Not Found with message 'employee not found'

Title: Delete employee with null id
Description: Verify deleting an employee with null id returns 400 status with message
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'id is required'

Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId and absent
Description: Verify marking attendance with valid employeeId and absent fields returns 200 and attendance data
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing valid employeeId and absent
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance data with employeeId, date, and absent
Expected Result: Response status 200 with attendance data containing employeeId=1 and absent=true

Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId, absent and date
Description: Verify marking attendance with valid employeeId, absent and date returns 200 and attendance data
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing valid employeeId, absent and date
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance data with employeeId, date, and absent
Expected Result: Response status 200 with attendance data containing employeeId=1, absent=false and date=2024-06-01

Title: Mark attendance with null request body
Description: Verify marking attendance with null request body returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with null body
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required to enter'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'employeeId and absent required to enter'

Title: Mark attendance with missing employeeId
Description: Verify marking attendance with missing employeeId returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body missing employeeId
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required to enter'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'employeeId and absent required to enter'

Title: Mark attendance with missing absent field
Description: Verify marking attendance with missing absent field returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body missing absent field
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required to enter'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'employeeId and absent required to enter'
